facts.business: Modipon Limited is a listed company that closed its manufacturing operations in 2007 and sold its entire plant and machinery by 2010.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (I) Balance confirmation certificates not obtained from creditors, loans and advances, security depositors, in-operative bank accounts, and PNB loan account; (II) Interest of Rs 1000.54 Lakhs not provided up to March 31, 2008 on overdue amounts to a supplier, and interest for period April 1, 2008 to March 31, 2026 not ascertained; (III) Interest to Small and Micro Enterprises for period April 1, 2007 to March 31, 2026 not ascertained; (IV) Land sale in 2009 without clear title transfer details; (V) Ongoing litigation with Punjab National Bank regarding OTS terms and NCLT/DRT proceedings.

key_risks: Ongoing litigation with Punjab National Bank under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 and DRT proceedings
Non-provision of interest on overdue amounts to suppliers and MSMEs leading to understatement of liabilities
Absence of balance confirmations from creditors, lenders, and depositors
Uncertainty regarding land title transfer for 65,743 sq.yds sold in 2009
Company has no manufacturing operations since 2007 and sold entire plant & machinery by 2010
